12 October 2026 — original government acquisition checkpoint.

Fixed XL: **233 catalogue-installed / 288 absent of 521**. Whole-map reporting: **346,108 source forms**, 4,516 enhanced forms and 6,649 native asset entries. These are forms/assets, not unique physical buildings. The completed checks below add **zero installations**.

ROOT independently verified exact completed results on pinned Neon (billowing-surf-67227217 / br-icy-silence-b3wjwz0q / neondb), all evidence references and released worker leases:

- **Upton whole-parent government-terrain comparison:** job `3046002072e7956b8d862a6a0ed14a66055fa962bfa3ccbef9401286910b4899`, 8,207 references, pushed in `5c9385d3c`. All 13,704 owned facets and 616 retained-native facets pass ordinary source-terrain coverage/clearance across four arithmetic bindings. Of 52 affected BASIC rows, 584 previously unproved facets become clear, nine current-clear whole facets cross the replacement domain and lack source coverage, and 266 remain unproved on both terrains. This supports a bounded original-terrain/current-exterior join; it does not approve a replacement.
- **Southside authentic original-ground obligations:** job `53845e3a5064414008f95ea813e8307fe305e0caa7874a968213274573b3ae26`, 890 references, pushed in `71c89dd61`. Complete 51,560 facet slots preserved; 106 mall and 50 station diagnostic paths qualify across all four bindings. Twelve nonsteep facets, missing-grade facet 3009, vacuous paths, an exposure failure and all 19 historical component obligations remain explicit.
- **West Wing original mounting interfaces:** job `6e368cf0ad826dac3d7c21a89593183403470fb9cf32ba7c07b50cd7506b92aa`, 1,559 references, pushed in `315f11f65`. Body108 retains four rim associations and its opening rejection. Body113 has one complete finite-band side; three boundaries remain partial/free.
- **Southside focused original source review:** job `33c07a92b0de482754195c337a94718f090f0572d4503658b05d3a21da0ab98d`, 906 references, pushed in `adf5ad390`. All 832 body/mode accounts, 52 target records and 19 historical-to-current mappings preserved. ROOT inspected actual exported images; historical pages are plan/elevation projections, not oblique 3D or GPU views.
- **West Wing typed source context:** job `38eaf53948efac4fa3ee79a598376907e3226e60b45c57a5e1180da31903d42c`, 1,575 references, pushed in `498eac168`. Bodies108/113 have source-specific visual descriptions, without engineering/support acceptance. Their main-body0 hosts still need qualification. All 118 bodies, 42 genuine ordinary failures and 443 strict warnings remain recorded; ordinary-clear facets are not newly failed merely for lacking strict clearance.

**Next work:** Upton private terrain-join construction with full affected-neighbour/seam/runtime gates; Southside bounded oblique source/host review; West Wing source-bound reconciliation of the 42 existing grade/cap routes and remaining component obligations. Existing unchanged expensive proofs are reused, not recomputed for counts. Routine schema/import failures are preserved as script failures, not model corruption.

Executor: Codex ROOT with the three existing user-requested acquisition agents. Acquisition skill `1.9.56`; local ROOT verification notes and portable handoff are committed. Original government building geometry, 1× scale and placement remain unchanged; **zero AI geometry modelling**. Optimisation framework/loader instructions are present, but this acquisition run starts no optimisation batch, variant approval or publication. Broader XL completion remains unproven; issues are not closed.
